title: The WalkUp: a concept site for the bar upstairs
tag: Concept site · cocktail bar, Cary, NC
summaryLead: A concept site for the cocktail bar one flight up in downtown Cary. Not a launched project.
story: The WalkUp is a cocktail bar one flight up in downtown Cary, NC, right above happy's. First-time visitors walk past the door because they do not know it is upstairs. This concept is our own work, built to turn that fact into the page itself. A 14-step meter fills as you scroll from the street to Suite 200, and the menu and running tab sit in the room at the top.

features.title: Scroll staircase
features.text: A 14-step meter fills with gold as you scroll from the street to Suite 200.

features.title: Menu and running tab
features.text: 49 items in tabs, five specialty cocktail cards and a tab that never leaves the page.

features.title: Vector logo
features.text: Traced into one SVG symbol, reused in the nav, hero and footer.
